gloss: the present day; nowadays; (up to) today

definitions.gloss: the present day; nowadays; (up to) today
definitions.explanation: The present age, as against the past: how things stand now ({今日|こんにち}ある), the stretch of time up to now ({今日|こんにち}まで), and the society and conditions of our time ({今日|こんにち}の{社会|しゃかい}). Formal; at home in speeches, essays and the news.

examples.japanese: {今日|こんにち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
{今日|こんにち}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧です。
examples.english: That we are where we are today is thanks to all of you.

examples.japanese: {今日|こんにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまな⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えている→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧。
examples.english: Japan today faces a variety of challenges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{今日|こんにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧だ。
examples.english: The company has lasted to this day thanks to its employees.

examples.japanese: {今日|こんにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}がれて→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧きた。
examples.english: This tradition has been passed down to this very day.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{今日|こんにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, life today has changed dramatically.

notes:
Read こんにち, {今日|こんにち} means the present day or the present age, not this particular calendar day.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今日|こんにち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (nowadays, in the present day)
- {今日|こんにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (to this day, up to the present)
- {今日|こんにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (today's society)
- {今日|こんにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (modern-day Japan)

WATCH OUT:
こんにち is not a formal way of saying ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧ (this day). Even in formal speech, today's date or schedule takes きょう or the formal ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ or {今日|きょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (today's meeting), never こんにち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧. The one exception is the greeting ⟦こんにちは→こんにちは：02839_konnichiha⟧ (hello), a fixed expression.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧: the modern era, as a period of history
- ⟦{近頃|ちかごろ}→近頃：00028_chikagoro⟧: lately; these days — everyday and less formal

cross_references.notes: Same kanji, different reading — きょう is the everyday word for 'today'
